Hi — I'm the Head of Retention at Pawsome Pantry, a specialty pet supplies brand. Our repeat purchase rate has dropped significantly this quarter and leadership is very concerned. I've put together two data files in our workspace under data/customers/: one called purchase_history.csv (every customer's spend history and last order date) and one called tier_points.csv (their loyalty tier and points balances with expiry dates). Our reference date is June 15, 2024.

I need you to analyze these files and produce a complete reactivation strategy document saved as winback_strategy.md. This should cover who's at risk of churning, what we should actually do about it segment by segment, and a concrete action plan our team can execute. Please make sure it's comprehensive enough that our CS team, marketing team, and ops team can all act on it independently.
